name: Rivora Hotel Booking
description: Rivora is a full-stack hotel booking and reservation management platform designed to provide a seamless hotel management experience. The system enables users to search available rooms, make reservations, complete secure payments, and manage bookings with real-time availability tracking. It includes separate dashboards for Admin, Manager, and Users with advanced room, booking, and account management features. The platform is built with modern technologies to ensure scalability, security, and a smooth user experience.
features: Real-time hotel room availability tracking to prevent double booking and scheduling conflicts
Complete room reservation system with dynamic check-in and check-out management
Advanced booking workflow with booking confirmation, cancellation, and status tracking
Real-time booking updates using Socket.io for instant synchronization
Secure online payment integration using SSLCOMMERZ payment gateway
JWT-based authentication with protected routes and secure session management
Role-based dashboard architecture for Admin, Manager, and User roles
Admin dashboard for managing users, hotels, rooms, bookings, and system analytics
Manager dashboard for controlling room inventory, reservations, check-in, and check-out operations
User dashboard for managing profiles, booking history, payments, and reservations
Dynamic room management system with room details, pricing, availability, and images
Automated booking status management system including pending, confirmed, checked-in, and completed states
Responsive modern UI built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI components
Optimized data fetching and caching using TanStack Query
Scalable backend architecture using Express.js and Prisma ORM
Secure database management with PostgreSQL
User-friendly search and filtering system for available rooms
Mobile-friendly design optimized for all screen sizes

name: Medicare Point
description: Medicare Point is a full-stack healthcare e-commerce platform that provides medicine purchasing, lab test booking, doctor consultation, and healthcare management services. The platform includes doctor appointment scheduling, prescription management, medicine ordering, lab test booking, and role-based dashboards for Admins, Users, and Pharmacists. It delivers a secure, scalable, and responsive healthcare ecosystem using modern MERN stack technologies.
features: Integrated healthcare ecosystem for medicine e-commerce, lab test booking, and professional health consultations
Doctor appointment booking with available schedule management and time slot selection system
Dynamic doctor availability tracking and appointment scheduling workflow
Triple dashboard architecture for Admin, User, and Pharmacist with role-based access control
Real-time chat system for communication between patients and healthcare providers
Automated notification and announcement management system
Prescription upload and medicine request functionality
Medicine ordering system with discount coupon and loyalty reward points
Secure online payment integration using Stripe payment gateway
Secure authentication and protected healthcare data management
Dynamic image gallery and prescription management system
Responsive and modern UI built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI
Optimized API data fetching and state management using Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query
Scalable backend architecture using Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Mongoose
Secure data validation and error handling for reliable application performance
Mobile-friendly design with smooth user experience across all devices

name: Tour Management System
description: Tour Management System is a full-stack travel management platform designed to simplify tour booking, scheduling, and travel operations. The platform allows users to explore available tour packages, check tour schedules based on start and end dates, book trips, manage payments, and receive automated notifications. It provides a complete management ecosystem with role-based dashboards for Admin, Tour Guides, and Users. The system handles real-time tour availability, secure authentication, booking management, PDF invoice generation, and scalable backend services using modern technologies.
features: Complete tour package management system with dynamic tour creation, updating, and deletion
Advanced tour scheduling system with start date and end date management
Automatic tour availability tracking based on scheduled travel dates
Real-time booking management system to handle user reservations efficiently
Secure online payment integration using SSLCOMMERZ payment gateway
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system for Admin, Tour Guide, and User roles
Admin dashboard for managing users, tours, bookings, payments, and platform activities
Tour Guide dashboard for managing assigned tours and traveler information
User dashboard for booking history, profile management, payments, and tour tracking
OTP-based authentication and verification system for secure user access
JWT-secured authentication with protected routes and authorization middleware
Redis integration for caching, session optimization, and improved application performance
File upload system using Multer for managing tour images and user documents
Automatic PDF invoice generation and download system using PDFKit
Booking confirmation and notification management system
Dynamic tour filtering based on location, category, price range, and availability
Responsive and modern UI built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI
Optimized API data fetching and state management using Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query
Scalable backend architecture using Express.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, and Mongoose
Secure data validation and error handling for reliable application performance
Mobile-friendly design with smooth user experience across all devices

name: FoodHunt
description: FoodHunt is a full-stack multi-vendor food ordering and delivery management platform designed to connect customers with food providers. The platform allows vendors to create profiles, manage food items, receive customer orders, and handle the complete order lifecycle from placement to delivery. Customers can explore food items, add products to their cart, place orders, complete secure payments, and track order status in real-time. The system provides separate dashboards for Admin, Providers, and Users with role-based permissions, ensuring secure and efficient food marketplace operations.
features: Multi-vendor food marketplace where sellers can create profiles and manage their food businesses
Provider profile creation system with restaurant information, food categories, and product management
Complete food item management including adding, updating, deleting, and managing availability
Customer food browsing system with search, filtering, and category-based exploration
Shopping cart management with Redux-powered global state handling
Complete order lifecycle management from order placement to delivery completion
Real-time order status updates using Socket.io technology
Secure online payment integration using SSLCOMMERZ payment gateway
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system for Admin, Provider, and User roles
Admin dashboard for managing users, providers, foods, orders, and platform activities
Provider dashboard for managing restaurant profiles, food inventory, incoming orders, and delivery status
User dashboard for managing profiles, carts, orders, payments, and order history
Real-time communication and notification system for order updates
Order tracking workflow including pending, confirmed, preparing, out-for-delivery, and completed states
Secure authentication with JWT-based protected routes and authorization middleware
Scalable backend architecture built with Go, Echo framework, and GORM ORM
PostgreSQL database integration for reliable data management
Responsive modern interface built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN UI
Optimized state management and API handling for better performance
Secure transaction handling with payment verification and order validation
Mobile-friendly design for seamless food ordering experience across devices

name: GizmoRent
description: GizmoRent is a modern gadget rental and e-commerce platform that allows users to explore, rent, and manage electronic products. The platform provides a smooth rental experience with product filtering, detailed product information, authentication, and efficient rental management features. It is designed with a responsive interface and scalable backend services for a seamless user experience.
features: Users can browse various gadgets, explore detailed product information, and easily select products based on their rental requirements.
Implemented advanced product filtering and searching functionality to help users quickly find suitable gadgets from available collections.
Integrated Firebase authentication system for secure user registration, login management, and protected application features.
Developed gadget rental workflow allowing users to request rentals and manage their rented products efficiently.
Created responsive and modern user interfaces ensuring smooth experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Built scalable backend APIs using Node.js and Express.js for managing products, users, and rental operations.
Implemented structured product management system for maintaining gadget details, categories, pricing, and availability status.

name: AB Agency
description: AB Agency is a professional digital service platform designed for businesses to showcase their services, portfolios, and online solutions. The platform provides a modern corporate website experience with responsive design, optimized performance, and a clean structure to improve client engagement and business presentation.
features: Designed a professional agency platform to showcase digital services, business solutions, and company portfolio information.
Developed dynamic service sections allowing businesses to present their offerings with an attractive modern interface.
Implemented responsive layouts ensuring consistent user experience across different devices and screen sizes.
Built reusable components using Next.js architecture for better maintainability and scalable frontend development.
Used TypeScript to create a type-safe and reliable development environment with improved code quality.
Optimized website performance using Next.js features including efficient rendering and improved loading experience.
Created a clean and modern UI design focused on improving user engagement and business credibility.
